asks: May the agent's own summary be shown beside a receipt?
answer: The agent's own summary of its work can be shown beside a receipt, never inside it, marked as the agent's own words. It is shown as plain text: nothing in it becomes a link or a button. In the text that the `silo` command prints, it is marked the same way, so that an agent reading a receipt can tell it from Silo's account. A summary can be wrong, or written to mislead. When there is no summary, or Silo does not have its text, the receipt says so.
